cover.main: WHERE SOUTH FLORIDA IS GOING OUT THIS WEEKEND

photo.query: South Florida concert venue exterior at night with arriving crowd
photo.prompt: dramatic night photo of a South Florida concert venue exterior with lights on and people arriving

slides.headline: Celia Vive! at Miramar Cultural Center, Oct. 10
slides.body: Oct. 10 at 8 p.m. at Miramar Cultural Center in Miramar. Tickets are $30 to $50. Lucrecia performs Celia Cruz songs with the Celia Cruz All Stars Band.

photo.query: Miramar Cultural Center stage performance salsa concert
photo.prompt: dramatic stage photo with salsa lights, a live band and a packed theater in Miramar

slides.headline: Ricky Martin at Hard Rock Live, Oct. 10
slides.body: Oct. 10 at 8 p.m. at Hard Rock Live in Hollywood. Tickets start at $55 and go to $935. Ricky Martin plays his biggest hits.

photo.query: Hard Rock Live Hollywood concert crowd stage lights
photo.prompt: dramatic concert photo inside Hard Rock Live with bright stage lights and a packed crowd

slides.headline: Zuccaly soft opening in Coral Gables, Oct. 10 to 12
slides.body: Open Saturday and Sunday from 1 to 8 p.m. at The Plaza Coral Gables in Coral Gables. The new Italian food hall has six stations, a market and a full bar.

photo.query: Italian food hall Coral Gables pasta pizza wine interior
photo.prompt: dramatic food hall photo with fresh pasta, Roman-style pizza, gelato and wine under warm lights

slides.headline: Black Violin at Broward Center, Oct. 11
slides.body: Oct. 11 at 7 p.m. at Broward Center in Fort Lauderdale. Tickets start at $23 and go to $105. Braxton Cook opens the show.

photo.query: Black Violin concert stage Fort Lauderdale Broward Center
photo.prompt: dramatic stage photo of two violinists performing under blue and purple lights

slides.headline: Deering Estate ghost tours in Miami, through Oct. 29
slides.body: Tours run Tuesdays and Thursdays through Oct. 29 at Deering Estate in Miami. The experience starts after dark and allows paranormal equipment.

photo.query: Deering Estate Miami historic house at night flashlight tour
photo.prompt: moody night photo of Deering Estate with flashlights and people walking toward the historic house

slides.headline: Miami Fashion Week, Oct. 13 to 18
slides.body: Miami Fashion Week runs Oct. 13 to 18 in Miami. The anniversary edition brings runway shows and related events across the week.

photo.query: Miami Fashion Week runway lights models audience
photo.prompt: dramatic fashion runway photo with bright lights, seated crowd and a model on the catwalk

South Florida has concerts, dinner plans and late-night events on the calendar this week.
